verdict.rationale: Baseten's Truss format keeps model code, weights, and config in an open, portable format ('write once, run anywhere') and training checkpoints are synced to storage, giving some model-artifact portability, but there is no documented feature for exporting workspace data, usage logs, deployment history, or other platform data in open formats to leave the platform entirely. missing for 10: explicit data-export tooling, documentation of exporting usage/logs/config data, confirmation that all account data (not just model artifacts) can be extracted without vendor assistance.
